subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the above passage, fill in the blanks with
stimulus: suitable words. Use one word only in each blank. 15=5 Once Bangladesh was not an independent country. Then is was (a) ⎯ by the British. Bengal lost its (b) ⎯ in the battle of Palassey in 1757. The (c) ⎯ independent Nawab Siraj was defeated because of conspiracy. The British ruled this country (d) ⎯ 190 years. But the people of Bengal are very daring ones and they (e) ⎯ back their independence in 1971 after a bloody war. ক্যাপটেন SSC English Test Papers
